name: Paul Vixie
org: DEC; Internet Software Consortium / ISC (co-founder); MAPS; Farsight Security; Amazon Web Services
why_notable: Principal maintainer of BIND from the late 1980s through the 1990s, first at Digital Equipment Corporation, and co-founder of the Internet Software Consortium (now Internet Systems Consortium), which still develops BIND and dig. For the BIND 4.9 release he merged Steve Hotz's dig back into the BIND distribution, linking it against libresolv and nslookup code so it shipped with BIND from then on. He wrote Vixie cron, co-authored several DNS RFCs, founded MAPS (the first DNS-based spam blocklist) and Farsight Security (passive DNS), and was inducted into the Internet Hall of Fame in 2014.
